title: OnlyFans Mom Leaves Toddler to Starve With Dead Baby

beats.description: Opening with dramatic soundbites: mother claims baby was murdered, warning about KK, and narrator sets up a house of unimaginable horror.
Narrator introduces the case: 911 call leads to discovery of abandoned children, missing mother posts desperate video. Date and location established (Yakima, WA, Feb 25, 2025).
911 call from concerned friend; Kylia's Snapchat video playing; police dispatched to her home.
Police enter the home, find deceased 7-month-old Cherry in bassinet with signs of decay; discover alive but severely malnourished 2-year-old in crib.
Kylia continues filming, blames babysitter KK; police locate her at Squall Rock Resort and arrest her.
Details of Kylia's arrest at McDonald's on Feb 24; timeline of her activities with friends Brad and Emma; she claims kids were with sitter.
Friends and parents express doubt about KK's existence; Kylia's history of neglect described by multiple witnesses (diaper rash, feeding issues).
Hospital photos show toddler's emaciated condition; Kylia's parents reveal they called CPS but were dismissed; Kylia admits to OnlyFans and drug use.
Interrogation: Kylia's timeline is incoherent; she admits to finding Cherry dead but leaving without calling 911, then overdosing on cocaine.
KK is identified as Cara, who has been in jail for 3 weeks — impossible for her to have babysat. Kylia's story collapses.
Kylia's parents visited on Feb 23 but were kept from the bedroom; Kylia texted lies about the kids sleeping. Detective shows photos of toddler's emaciation.
Kylia's ex-boyfriend Rock reveals she previously let two dogs starve (one died, one rescued); pattern of abandonment confirmed.
Autopsy confirms Cherry died of malnutrition/dehydration; timeline shows Kylia was partying while toddler starved; TikTok posts during the period.
Friends and family express devastation; Kylia's mother confronts her on phone: 'Your daughter is dead and the other might not survive.'
Narrator summarizes charges: first-degree manslaughter, family abandonment, criminal mistreatment, animal cruelty. Kylia pleads not guilty.
Trial scheduled for June 2026; toddler survived against odds; channel promotion for Patreon and early access.
